text:
Maya: Need a compact benchmark narrative for next weekwebinar + 1-pager. Focus: latency SLOs vs $/token. One hero, three charts, two CTAs.

Jon: Proposed structure: hero claim + one-liner, latency panel (median/p95/p99 across models & deploy modes), cost waterfall (model, infra, optimizations), recommended configs table (Startup/Scale/Enterprise).

Priya: Data slices: model, deploy_mode, quant, seq_bucket, median_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, cost_per_1k_usd, cache_hit_rate, batch_profile. Prompt mix: 55/30/15 short/med/long.

DesignBot: Visuals: small multiples for latency violins, stacked waterfall bars, tiny persona table. Keep captions short (8-12 words). Use brand palette.

Maya: Hero options (short):
- A: "Latency you can promise. Costs you can forecast."
- B: "Fast median. Tame tail. Lower $/token."
- C: "Serve fast. Save every token."
Pick one for slide, alternate for socials.

Jon: I'll export CSV to s3://bench-exports/2026/marketing/bench-5110000000.csv by Mon 14:00 UTC. Will include cache/no-cache rows.

DataBot: Schema validated in preview. Reminder: include batch_profile values: none, moderate, aggressive.

Priya: I'll draft hero + three slide captions and a 1-paragraph blog lead by Mon noon.

Maya: Great. Two CTAs: "Run your prompts 1 See your numbers" and "Request a Dedicated eval." Final deck Tue AM.

DesignBot: Mockups queued after CSV. Will post previews in thread. :eyes:

Jon: CSV uploaded preview link: https://internal.redwood/bench/preview/5110000000 (private).

Maya: Thanks team. Check-in Mon 4pm. :rocket:
